name: Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA) - 'Las Vegas' patch
verdict: The Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA) was founded by the Nevada Legislature in 1955 as a governmental entity to serve this destination.
note: Rating note: LVCVA is a state agency created by statute; Nevada is a U.S. state with no ongoing armed conflict or severe abuses, but state ownership triggers serious tier per rubric. ON HOLD: public ownership, but no sourced claim of abuses by that owner, which serious needs.
